ORDINANCE XXXV OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
ENTERTAINMENT S DUTY AMENDMENT
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Entertainments Duty
Act, 1958
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
20th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2-42/Law/79/IV, dated 20‑10‑2001.----The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 15th October, 2001,
is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Balochistan Entertainments Duty (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3 of W.P. Act X of .1958

ORDINANCE XXXV OF 2001
ORDINANCE XXXV OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
ENTERTAINMENT S DUTY AMENDMENT
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Entertainments Duty
Act, 1958
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
20th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2-42/Law/79/IV, dated 20‑10‑2001.----The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on 15th October, 2001,
is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 3 of
W.P. Act X of .1958.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Entertainments
Duty Act, 1958, after the proviso of sub section (1) of section 3, full stop
appearing at the end of Explanation I shall be substituted by a colon and
thereafter the following new proviso shall be substituted:‑‑
"Provided
that only in case of Cinema Houses where entertainment duty shall be levied and
paid at the rate of twenty five per cent. of such payments excluding the amount
of the duty."
